capabilities: Export a note or folder as self-contained HTML with inline styles and optional local images
Navigate exported pages with a clickable and scrolling table of contents
Underline selected text and add annotations that sync back to the source Markdown note
Copy all highlights on a page to the clipboard
Open exported .html files directly from the Obsidian file explorer
disambiguation: Not a web publishing tool; it writes standalone .html files to the vault for offline reading and archiving, not publishing to a website.
extras: Full English installation and usage instructions are in a separate README.en.md; the README is mostly Chinese with an English overview. Desktop only for now; no external services are used and all processing stays in the local vault.
problem: Obsidian's reading views are tied to Markdown, so long notes are hard to read offline, share as single files, or annotate with highlights that persist back to the source.
summary: Exports Markdown notes or folders as self-contained HTML pages with a table of contents, reading styles, and in-app annotation.
